prompt: Check whether our agent needs another approved package before it turns the attached product brief into a launch video. The current packages are listed in installed.md and the approved catalog is in catalog.md. Give one compact decision and don't install or create anything.

rubric.description: States that the need is already covered by product-launch-video.
Does not recommend or install another package.
Explains that the installed package already contains the relevant procedure.
Returns one compact decision rather than doing the video task.

why_skill_should_matter: SkillNeed explicitly checks loaded and available Skills before searching and rejects duplicates.
